This plot is not mine — I rent it, so I will not put too much money into the soil. Last season I managed with one bag of NPK and a little urea on top, and the maize did fair, so I will do the same. I cannot afford improved seed every year, but my sister gave me some grain from her harvest that came from improved seed, so I will plant that. I have no money for pesticide and no way to irrigate here in the north — I wait for the rains like everyone else.
